description: Oak Ridge National Laboratory releases a Python script for generating AutoBEM representative building archetypes by Weather Research and Forecasting grid cell. Zenodo archives an open source bundle with generic `other-open` rights metadata. The linked GitHub repository identifies BSD-3-Clause and documents `WRF_Archetypes_Parallel.py`: it spatially joins a WRF-zone shapefile with a building descriptor CSV, groups representative buildings and calculates floor-area multipliers, writing an archetype CSV. Its example uses Clark County AutoBEM building data and a WRF grid. This data-preparation tool can reduce a city-scale building energy simulation from many individual models to weighted representatives. A related catalogue record describes the national Model America source but not this grid-cell builder. A limitation is that archetype weights depend on correct source areas, map projection and WRF-zone geometry; they do not validate energy predictions. The README cites GeoPandas 0.9.0 and an example with 72 cores, so current compatibility is untested. No code was downloaded or run.
